basic_information.official_title: AN ACT UPGRADING THE SULU PROVINCIAL HOSPITAL INTO A LEVEL II HOSPITAL, INCREASING ITS BED CAPACITY TO TWO HUNDRED (200), UPGRADING ITS PROFESSIONAL HEALTH CARE SERVICES AND FACILITIES, AUTHORIZING THE INCREASE OF ITS MEDICAL PERSONNEL, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
signed_by: Prof. Raby B. Angkal, Secretary General
basic_information.effectivity: 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation

citizen_summary.what_is_this_about: Upgrades the Sulu Provincial Hospital to Level II, doubles its beds from 100 to 200, and — unusually for these hospital acts — sets a three-year funding schedule of 40%, 30% and 30% starting in 2022.
citizen_summary.why_was_it_proposed: To raise the province's main hospital to Level II standards and expand its capacity, with the staffing and facilities to match.
citizen_summary.what_will_change: Bed capacity doubles to 200 under Level II classification. Professional services, staffing complements and facilities are upgraded to national DOH standards, with additional plantilla positions to be determined and filled.
who_will_be_affected: Health workers, through the new plantilla positions to be created and filled
citizen_summary.when_will_it_take_effect: In force since 2022, with funding scheduled across three tranches from calendar year 2022.

what_this_means_for_you.in_short: NOW LAW. Sulu's provincial hospital doubles to 200 beds at Level II — and this one comes with a payment schedule: 40% in year one, 30% in each of the next two.
in_practice: 100 beds becomes 200, at Level II classification
Professional services, staffing complements and facilities upgraded to national DOH standards
Additional plantilla positions to be determined and filled on the hospital's recommendation
Budget apportioned in three tranches from 2022: 40% / 30% / 30%
Under the direct supervision and control of the Ministry of Health – BARMM

for_specific_groups.Patients in Sulu: Level II services and twice the beds at the province's main hospital.
for_specific_groups.Health workers: Section 3 requires additional plantilla positions to be determined and filled up, following the hospital administration's recommendations.
for_specific_groups.Anyone tracking delivery: Section 5 gives a schedule — the only one of the June 2022 hospital acts to do so alongside BAA 29.

what_this_means_for_you.when_you_will_feel_it: Funding began in calendar year 2022 and ran across three tranches.
what_you_can_do: Ask MOH-BARMM which tranche has been released and what was delivered against it
Ask about the additional plantilla positions created under Section 3
watch_out_for: The tranches are percentages of an amount the act never states.
No completion deadline for the physical works.
'Plantilla positions to be created and filled up' depends on the finance ministry's concurrence.

key_terms_explained.Level II hospital: A facility with specialist departments beyond basic emergency and general medicine.
key_terms_explained.Plantilla position: A permanent, funded post in the government staffing structure.
key_terms_explained.Tranche: One instalment of a budget released in stages.
key_terms_explained.RLED: Regulation and Licensing Enforcement Division of the regional health ministry.

what_this_means_for_you.status_note: Passed Dhu Al-Qa'dah 17, 1443 / 16 June 2022, approved by the Chief Minister on 12 July 2022.

benefits.headline: 200 beds at Level II for Sulu's provincial hospital, on a three-year funding schedule.

direct_benefits.how_to_access: Plantilla positions determined by RLED with MFBM on the hospital's recommendation

indirect_benefits: A stated funding schedule against which delivery can be measured
limitations: The act names no peso amount, so the percentages have no base.

for_citizens: None. The act imposes no duty on the public.

what_is_prohibited: The act defines no prohibited acts and creates no offences.

penalties.for_citizens: None. The act creates no offence, fine or imprisonment.

where_to_complain.oversight: Ministry of Health – BARMM, which has direct supervision and control and whose Minister issues implementing orders in consultation with hospital management
where_to_complain.note: The act creates no complaints procedure of its own.

everyday_scenarios: A patient in Jolo needing specialist care that previously meant leaving the province should find it at the upgraded provincial hospital.
A nurse asks whether new permanent posts exist. Section 3 requires the additional plantilla positions to be determined and filled on the hospital's recommendation.

key_provisions: Section 1 — Upgrades the Sulu Provincial Hospital into a Level II hospital and increases bed capacity from 100 to 200, under the direct supervision and control of the Ministry of Health – BARMM.
Section 2 — Existing professional health care services, staffing complements and facilities are upgraded accordingly, in compliance with national Department of Health standards.

Section 3 — The Regulation and Licensing Enforcement Division of MOH-BARMM, coordinating with the Ministry of Finance, and Budget and Management, shall immediately include the operational guidelines of a Level II facility in the Ministry's programme and determine the additional plantilla positions to be created and filled following the recommendations of the hospital administration.
Section 4 — The Bangsamoro Autonomous Government shall provide the necessary funds for the upgrading and increase in bed capacity.

Section 5 — Personnel Services and Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses are included in the annual General Appropriations Act of the Bangsamoro. The budget is apportioned in three tranches beginning in calendar year 2022: Year 1 – 40%, Year 2 – 30%, Year 3 – 30%.
Section 6 — The Minister of MOH-BARMM, in consultation with hospital management, issues the orders, rules and circulars needed to implement the act.
Section 9 — Takes effect 15 days after publication in a newspaper of regional circulation.

citizen_questions.q: How big will the hospital be?
citizen_questions.a: 200 beds, doubled from 100, at Level II classification.
Yes — one of only two in the June 2022 hospital cluster. The budget is apportioned in three tranches from calendar year 2022: 40%, then 30%, then 30%.
Section 3 requires additional plantilla positions to be determined and filled, on the hospital administration's recommendation, by the health ministry's licensing division with the finance ministry.

citizen_questions.q: How much money is that in pesos?
citizen_questions.a: The act does not say. It gives percentages without stating the total.
